summary: aTyr Pharma filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing FDA alignment on the protocol for a global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 study of efzofitimod in chronic symptomatic pulmonary sarcoidosis with restrictive lung disease. The 54-week trial will randomize up to approximately 372 patients equally to 5.0 mg/kg intravenous efzofitimod or placebo every three weeks for 17 doses, with FVC change at week 48 as the primary endpoint and KSQ-Lung as key secondary. Study activities begin Q4 2026; no M&A, tender, or capital-structure terms are stated, and the company acknowledges needing additional capital.
